entries.zh: 首頁全球延誤與取消改為連結至 FlightAware 公開即時統計，移除未設定來源提示。
entries.en: Replaced unavailable homepage disruption totals with a link to FlightAware's public live statistics.

entries.zh: 精簡喀拉喀托之子火山照片圖說，拍攝日期保留於圖片資料。
entries.en: Shortened the Anak Krakatau photo caption while retaining its capture date in image metadata.

entries.zh: 加入喀拉喀托之子火山的對應歷史資料照片，保留作者、授權與來源資訊。
entries.en: Added a matching historical file photo for Anak Krakatau with author, licence and source attribution.

entries.zh: 新聞圖片顯示可驗證的主體描述並保留原始圖說；缺少可信描述時使用已標示的網站預設圖。
entries.en: Added verified image-subject descriptions and original captions, with a labelled site fallback when reliable descriptions are unavailable.

entries.zh: 修正 Simple Flying 媒體名稱誤譯，並加入標題、摘要與內文的用詞檢查。
entries.en: Corrected mistranslations of Simple Flying and added terminology checks for headlines, summaries and article text.

entries.zh: 調整圖片清理與發布前檢查順序，讓既有錯圖能先被修正，再驗證更新內容。
entries.en: Reordered image cleanup and pre-publication checks so existing mismatches can be corrected before validation.

entries.zh: 配圖優先依標題與摘要中的主要機型判斷，避免使用內文僅供比較的其他機型照片。
entries.en: Prioritised aircraft types in headlines and summaries to avoid photos of aircraft mentioned only for comparison.

entries.zh: 擴充亞洲航空公司機隊新聞與海南航空官方資訊來源，保留原始發布者署名。
entries.en: Expanded Asian airline fleet coverage and official Hainan Airlines sources while preserving original publisher attribution.

entries.zh: 穩定手機版即時快訊字型，分別調整新聞文字與時間的字級及字重。
entries.en: Stabilised mobile live-ticker typography with separate sizing and weights for stories and timestamps.

entries.zh: 修正 iPhone 頁首標誌載入時的短暫留白，以及即時快訊文字超出顯示範圍的問題。
entries.en: Fixed transient iPhone header spacing during logo loading and ticker text painting outside its viewport.

entries.zh: 移除自動撰稿中持續失效的模型路由，減少重複失敗請求造成的更新延遲。
entries.en: Removed persistently failing automatic drafting routes to reduce update delays from repeated failed requests.

entries.zh: 改善區域航空品牌與母品牌的配圖辨識，避免誤擋符合機型的資料照片。
entries.en: Improved regional-airline and parent-brand image matching to avoid rejecting valid aircraft file photos.

entries.zh: 早、午、晚快報各自提供完整過去 24 小時匯總，並將臺灣航空分為民航與軍航。
entries.en: Made each morning, afternoon and evening briefing a complete 24-hour digest, with separate Taiwan civil and military aviation sections.

entries.zh: 加入導覽路徑結構化資料，改善網站地圖更新日期、文章作者及社群分享資訊。
entries.en: Added breadcrumb structured data and improved sitemap modification dates, article authorship and social-sharing metadata.

entries.zh: 改善 iPad 直式導覽、首頁閱讀順序與雷達單欄排列，避免頁面橫向溢位。
entries.en: Improved portrait iPad navigation, homepage reading order and single-column radar layout without horizontal overflow.

entries.zh: 補齊中英文社群分享語系與預覽圖片替代文字。
entries.en: Completed Chinese and English social-sharing locale metadata and preview-image alternative text.

entries.zh: 機場 IATA 代碼在標題與內文首次提及時分別標註；未找到合適配圖的近期文章持續重試至第七天。
entries.en: Annotated airport IATA codes independently in headlines and article text, and continued missing-image retries through day seven.

entries.zh: 修正營運統計欄位與來源狀態，區分資料來源未設定及暫時無法取得。
entries.en: Corrected operational-statistics fields and distinguished unconfigured sources from temporarily unavailable data.

entries.zh: 新聞索引加入分頁，強化機場代碼與原始來源連結，避免公開頁面使用未解析的新聞聚合網址。
entries.en: Added news-index pagination and strengthened airport-code and original-source links, excluding unresolved aggregator URLs from public pages.

entries.zh: 新增中英文新聞索引與 RSS，延後載入搜尋索引，並加強新聞主題及近期配圖檢查。
entries.en: Added bilingual news indexes and RSS, deferred search-index loading and strengthened story-scope and recent-image checks.

entries.zh: 天氣造成國籍航空航班異動的頭條優先顯示期限縮短為 16 小時。
entries.en: Shortened homepage priority for weather-related national-airline flight changes to 16 hours.

entries.zh: 強化近期新聞配圖相關性，排除不符主題的航空公司、機型、航廈、機艙與事故照片。
entries.en: Strengthened recent-news image relevance checks against unrelated airlines, aircraft, terminals, cabins and accident imagery.

entries.zh: 機場簡稱也納入首次 IATA 代碼標註，補齊芝加哥奧黑爾機場別名辨識。
entries.en: Included airport short names in first-mention IATA annotation and added Chicago O'Hare aliases.

entries.zh: 首頁可輪播符合條件的天氣與國籍航空航班異動新聞，每五分鐘切換。
entries.en: Added five-minute homepage rotation for qualifying weather-related national-airline flight-change stories.

entries.zh: 一般航空公司新聞的備援配圖排除機艙內裝，優先使用符合業者的飛機外觀照片。
entries.en: Excluded cabin interiors from generic airline image fallbacks in favour of matching exterior aircraft photos.

entries.zh: 首頁本週嚴重事件可連到相同統計範圍的事故清單，再開啟完整新聞。
entries.en: Linked the homepage weekly serious-event count to the matching incident list and full articles.

entries.zh: 擴大首頁與主題頁新聞摘要的可用寬度，改善桌面版提早換行。
entries.en: Expanded summary width on home and topic pages to reduce premature desktop line wrapping.

entries.zh: 多起獨立事件的飛安彙整維持中性預設圖，避免後續配圖流程重新附加單一事件照片。
entries.en: Kept neutral imagery for multi-event safety roundups and prevented later fallback stages from attaching single-event photos.

entries.zh: 飛安彙整明確區分不相關事件，補足機型與地點說明，避免將整篇彙整當成單一事故。
entries.en: Separated unrelated events in safety roundups, expanded aircraft and location descriptions and avoided treating a roundup as one incident.

entries.zh: 統一使用航空用語「機齡」，避免誤植為「車齡」。
entries.en: Standardised the Chinese term for aircraft age and prevented the road-vehicle equivalent.

entries.zh: 調整 iPhone 頁首 SVG 標誌的載入方式，減少縮放時的灰色毛邊。
entries.en: Adjusted iPhone header SVG loading to reduce grey fringes during scaling.

entries.zh: 加入摘要句子邊界檢查，避免既有截斷方式留下不完整句子。
entries.en: Added summary-boundary checks to prevent incomplete sentences caused by legacy truncation.

entries.zh: 統一 Heathrow Airport 的臺灣慣用譯名為「希斯洛機場」。
entries.en: Standardised the Taiwan Chinese rendering of Heathrow Airport.

entries.zh: 頁首與頁尾統一使用核准的 SKYTICAL 標誌母版，移除額外重描的翼形疊圖。
entries.en: Restored the approved SKYTICAL logo master in headers and footers and removed the redrawn wing overlay.

entries.zh: 發布前依可信機場資料庫補齊首次提及的 IATA 代碼；無法唯一辨識的名稱不猜測代碼。
entries.en: Added database-backed first-mention airport IATA annotation before publication without guessing ambiguous names.

entries.zh: 擴充世界民航雜誌相關可信來源，支援跨來源新聞查證。
entries.en: Added trusted sources associated with Airway magazine for cross-source news verification.

entries.zh: 配圖搜尋擴充至全球已辨識機場，保留授權與主題檢查及網站預設圖。
entries.en: Extended image search to identified airports worldwide while retaining licence, relevance and site-fallback checks.

entries.zh: 未取得可驗證新聞照片時，文章顯示附有說明的 SKYTICAL 預設圖。
entries.en: Added a clearly labelled SKYTICAL fallback image when a verified news photo is unavailable.

entries.zh: 正式網站啟用 skytical.tech，同步更新中英文網址、網站地圖與搜尋分享資訊。
entries.en: Launched skytical.tech and updated bilingual URLs, sitemaps and search and sharing metadata.

entries.zh: 調整 SKYTICAL 翼標與字樣的比例及對齊，同步更新圖示與社群預覽圖。
entries.en: Balanced the SKYTICAL wing and wordmark proportions and alignment, including icons and social previews.

entries.zh: 更新 SKYTICAL 彩色品牌標誌、頁首頁尾、網站圖示與社群分享圖片。
entries.en: Updated SKYTICAL colour branding across headers, footers, site icons and social-sharing images.

entries.zh: 民航局新聞優先採用對應官方現場照片，並加入資料照片年份檢查。
entries.en: Prioritised matching official CAA event photos and added age checks for file-photo fallbacks.

entries.zh: 新增航空主題頁、編輯與更正政策、網站地圖及新聞結構化資料，改善搜尋收錄。
entries.en: Added aviation topic pages, editorial and correction policies, sitemaps and news structured data for search discovery.

entries.zh: 補齊 7 月 29 日至 8 月 10 日的重要公開網站功能、新聞品質與介面更新紀錄。
entries.en: Backfilled significant public site, news-quality and interface changes from 29 July through 10 August.

entries.zh: 新聞摘要改為只顯示於首頁，內頁保留正文與搜尋引擎描述。
entries.en: Limited visible news summaries to the homepage while retaining article text and search metadata.

entries.zh: 修正摘要拆開人名、遺漏事件與只留下孤立關鍵字的問題。
entries.en: Prevented summaries from splitting names, dropping the event or leaving isolated keywords.

entries.zh: 首頁加入 Apple 風格重點摘要，快速呈現航空公司、地點、時間與影響。
entries.en: Added Apple-style homepage summaries covering the operator, place, time and impact at a glance.

entries.zh: 從搜尋結果開啟新聞時，短暫標示查詢關鍵字及其別名。
entries.en: Added brief in-article highlighting for search terms and their aliases after opening a result.

entries.zh: 將 Google 風格新聞搜尋欄移至全站頁首。
entries.en: Moved the Google-style news search field into the global site header.

entries.zh: 新聞搜尋加入航空公司簡稱與正式名稱的別名比對。
entries.en: Added airline short-name and formal-name alias matching to news search.

entries.zh: 搜尋欄依每日新聞內容產生即時搜尋提示。
entries.en: Added search suggestions generated from each day's published news.

entries.zh: 更換華航舊機配圖，並限制通用航空照片的年代差距。
entries.en: Replaced an outdated China Airlines image and limited the age gap for generic aircraft photos.

entries.zh: 加強航空公司與機型配圖一致性檢查，避免錯配其他業者照片。
entries.en: Strengthened airline and aircraft image matching to prevent unrelated operator photos.

entries.zh: 加強稀有航機的航空公司、所屬地區、機型與航線背景辨識。
entries.en: Improved rare-aircraft identification with operator, region, model and route context.

entries.zh: 新聞文末顯示實際使用的撰稿模型。
entries.en: Added the actual drafting model used to each article footer.

entries.zh: 撰稿規則要求保留新聞涉及機場的 IATA 代碼。
entries.en: Updated drafting rules to preserve IATA codes for airports named in a story.

entries.zh: 精簡新聞內文並禁止加入讀者不需要的資料處理與編輯流程敘述。
entries.en: Tightened article copy and banned reader-irrelevant descriptions of data and editorial processing.

entries.zh: 修正 iPhone 版面、導覽與新聞列表的響應式顯示。
entries.en: Corrected responsive layout, navigation and news-list display on iPhone.

entries.zh: 改善手機版 LIVE 快訊的字型大小與捲動速度。
entries.en: Improved the typography and scrolling speed of the mobile LIVE ticker.

entries.zh: 補齊多家航空公司的航班雷達代碼對照。
entries.en: Completed additional airline-code mappings used by the live flight radar.

entries.zh: 網站品牌更新為 SKYTICAL，套用新 Logo 與標語「SKYLINE TO AVIATION NEWS」。
entries.en: Rebranded the site as SKYTICAL with its new logo and the tagline “SKYLINE TO AVIATION NEWS.”

entries.zh: 透過中央社網站索引擴充台灣航空新聞來源。
entries.en: Expanded Taiwan aviation coverage through CNA's published site index.

entries.zh: 提高台灣航空公司與本地民航新聞的收錄優先度。
entries.en: Raised the collection priority of Taiwan airlines and local civil-aviation news.

entries.zh: 改善航班雷達的班號與航空公司代碼辨識。
entries.en: Improved flight-number and airline-code recognition on the live radar.

entries.zh: 補齊航班雷達顯示的航空公司中文名稱。
entries.en: Completed Chinese airline names displayed by the live flight radar.

entries.zh: 改善跨來源事件合併，讓同一新聞的補充資訊能共同支援撰稿。
entries.en: Improved cross-source event enrichment so related reports can jointly support drafting.

entries.zh: 新增 Aerospace Global News 航空新聞來源。
entries.en: Added Aerospace Global News as an aviation news source.

entries.zh: 新增 AeroTime 航空新聞來源。
entries.en: Added AeroTime as an aviation news source.

entries.zh: 建立撰稿模型優先順序與品質設定檔。
entries.en: Configured drafting-model priority and quality profiles.

entries.zh: 修正並回填每日快報頁面。
entries.en: Corrected and backfilled the Daily Briefing pages.

entries.zh: 全面調整網站更新紀錄，採用中性、精確且一致的技術用語
entries.en: Revised the site changelog with neutral, precise and consistent technical language

entries.zh: 新增雙語網站更新紀錄頁與全站頁尾入口
entries.en: Added a bilingual site changelog and a footer entry point on every page

entries.zh: 修正民航企業財報因附帶提及國防業務而誤分類為軍事新聞
entries.en: Prevented civil-company results from being classified as military solely because they mention secondary defence operations

entries.zh: 加入飛機與發動機製造商官方消息來源
entries.en: Added official aircraft and engine manufacturer news sources

entries.zh: 調整文章文末的撰稿模型署名
entries.en: Refined drafting-model credits in article footers

entries.zh: 人工覆核並發布瑞航 LX16 班戈煙霧改降事件
entries.en: Manually reviewed and published the SWISS LX16 Bangor smoke diversion

entries.zh: 簡化文章文末的自動生成聲明與模型署名
entries.en: Simplified the automated-generation notice and model credit in article footers

entries.zh: 撰稿流程加入可追溯的受控歷史脈絡與短訊降級
entries.en: Added traceable verified historical context and controlled brief fallback to drafting

entries.zh: 航班雷達加入 ICAO／IATA 呼號切換與起迄航點
entries.en: Added ICAO/IATA callsign switching and origin-destination routes to flight radar

entries.zh: 新增台灣民航 ADS-B 航班雷達
entries.en: Added the Taiwan civil ADS-B flight radar

entries.zh: 排除與航空或運輸無直接關係的軍事新聞
entries.en: Filtered military stories without a direct aviation or transport subject

entries.zh: 加強非相關新聞篩選並支援文章封存
entries.en: Strengthened relevance filtering and added article archiving

entries.zh: 加入完整新聞稿最低字數與段落要求
entries.en: Enforced minimum length and paragraph requirements for full articles

entries.zh: 修正 Gatwick 的台灣慣用譯名
entries.en: Corrected the Taiwan rendering of Gatwick

entries.zh: 新增軍事新聞分類與前端標籤
entries.en: Added the military news category and front-end label

entries.zh: 每小時建置前同步最新快報資料，避免部署競態覆蓋
entries.en: Synced current briefing data before hourly builds to prevent deployment races

entries.zh: 快報來源異常改用讀者可理解的中性說明
entries.en: Replaced internal service-limit details with neutral reader-facing source-availability notices

entries.zh: 在渲染階段同步執行快報與正式新聞的分流規則
entries.en: Enforced briefing-versus-formal-article separation during rendering

entries.zh: 快報改為獨立條列速報，不再鏡像正式新聞
entries.en: Made briefings standalone bulletins instead of mirrors of formal articles

entries.zh: 中國人民解放軍機艦動態報導加入本站已驗證統計作為比較脈絡
entries.en: Added verified AVWIRE statistics as comparison context for PLA aircraft and vessel activity reports

entries.zh: 首頁即時快訊列可直接開啟對應新聞
entries.en: Linked each homepage live-update item directly to its corresponding story

entries.zh: 僅有短摘要的來源改作發現索引，不直接寫成完整新聞
entries.en: Turned excerpt-only feeds into discovery indexes instead of full-article evidence

entries.zh: 新增內容完整性檢查，並對證據不足的衍生報導採取保守處理
entries.en: Added content-integrity checks and conservative handling for derivative reports with insufficient evidence

entries.zh: 加入程式化驗證的專有名詞台灣慣用譯名表
entries.en: Added a programmatically validated glossary for Taiwan-standard proper-name renderings

entries.zh: 檢索增強快報的失敗紀錄保留回應內容，以支援診斷
entries.en: Included response bodies in retrieval-augmented briefing failure diagnostics

entries.zh: 避免空白的檢索模型環境變數覆寫預設模型名稱
entries.en: Prevented an empty retrieval-model setting from overriding the default model ID

entries.zh: 快報測試版加入經核准的檢索增強資料掃描
entries.en: Added the approved retrieval-augmented source scan to the briefing preview

entries.zh: 快報採用標準化版型，並納入台灣軍事航空與交通來源
entries.en: Standardised the briefing format and added Taiwan military aviation and transport sources

entries.zh: 特殊航機觀測經自動化規則驗證後可直接發布
entries.en: Enabled direct publication of special-aircraft observations after automated rule-based verification

entries.zh: 新聞影像改為完整比例、全彩顯示並標示影像主體
entries.en: Changed news imagery to full-frame colour display with subject labels

entries.zh: 影像配對加入機場別名與主管機關來源備援
entries.en: Added airport aliases and official-agency source fallback to image matching

entries.zh: 官方網頁全文可進入撰稿流程以支援完整新聞
entries.en: Fed official-page full text into drafting to support full-length articles

entries.zh: 透過無須第三方 API 憑證的公開資料來源，自動配對具再利用授權的新聞影像
entries.en: Added automated matching of reusable news imagery through public sources that require no third-party API credentials

entries.zh: 新增依臺北固定時段產生的每日三次航空與交通快報
entries.en: Added three daily air-and-transport briefings on fixed Taipei windows

entries.zh: 依完整編輯準則重寫方法論頁
entries.en: Rewrote the methodology page to reflect the complete editorial standards

entries.zh: 文章文末開始標示實際撰稿模型
entries.en: Started crediting the actual drafting model in article footers

entries.zh: 加入台灣特殊航機抵達偵測與來源文字正規化
entries.en: Added Taiwan special-aircraft arrival detection and source-text normalisation

entries.zh: 完成模型推理設定的 12 項對抗式審查修正
entries.en: Resolved all 12 adversarial-review findings in the model reasoning profiles

entries.zh: 加入模型分級推理設定、DeepSeek V4 Pro 備援與可觀測性
entries.en: Added per-model reasoning profiles, a DeepSeek V4 Pro fallback route and improved observability

entries.zh: 完整性檢查排除的內容不再計入每輪撰稿上限
entries.en: Excluded completeness-check rejections from the per-run drafting cap

entries.zh: 新聞時效性時間窗改為可調整設定
entries.en: Made the news recency window configurable

entries.zh: 撰稿流程可處理編輯拒絕結果，並預先檢查資料完整性
entries.en: Added editorial-rejection handling and a code-level completeness pre-check

entries.zh: 在 CI 中對應既有 NVIDIA NIM 憑證環境變數
entries.en: Mapped the configured NVIDIA NIM credential environment variable in CI

entries.zh: 依模型服務政策建立模型層級備援路由
entries.en: Added model-level failover routing under the configured model-service policy

entries.zh: 撰稿系統升級為多供應商模型與編輯驗證引擎 v2
entries.en: Upgraded drafting to a multi-provider model and editorial verification engine v2

entries.zh: 網站改為置中 1280px 內容版面與側邊留白
entries.en: Changed the site to a centred 1280px content sheet with side gutters

entries.zh: 加入以公開來源為基礎、無模型 API 相依性的標題聚合模式，並完成 18 項審查修正
entries.en: Added public-source headline aggregation without model API dependencies and resolved 18 review findings

entries.zh: 匯入首批正式擷取資料並完成空狀態網站建置
entries.en: Imported the first production source data and completed the empty-state site build

entries.zh: 建立 AVWIRE：抓取、去重、撰稿、建置管線與每小時自動部署
entries.en: Created AVWIRE with fetch, dedupe, drafting, build and hourly deployment pipelines
